title: Legacy World Record (9:37 ChiefWes) - Scorned Wilderness & Kuldra Speedrun | RS: Dragonwilds 1.0.0.6
author: Tiger with the Bars
description:
This video is published with express authorization from the original creator (@wes7918) via co-ownership with @thelastiger. All community run highlights and techniques are shared in accordance with creator permissions and standard speedrunning community practices.

Wes, a veteran RuneScape player since 2003, set a world record speedrun of 9:37 for the Dragonwilds Scorned Wilderness Raid using a unique map-reset skip he discovered. He coordinated with this channel to have this run uploaded for maximum reach. Wes is excited to gain exposure and plans to continue pushing records for future raids.

Wes's Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/wesof6tune7
